newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine pension funds cancel 390,000 accounts.
newsitem.headline: Argentine pension funds cancel 390,000 accounts.

text.p: Argentina's private pension funds have cancelled the accounts of 390,000 members because no payments have been received from them, the funds' watchdog, Superintendencia de AFJP (SAFJP), said Tuesday.

The SAFJP, which reached the decision with the government's tax office, indicated that it had plans to introduce an automatic updating system every quarter in an effort to prevent future cancellations.
The 390,000 had been in the lists of the pension funds since October 1995.
Before this announcement, there were some 5.3 million members of Argentina's private pension funds, which were introduced in mid-1994.
The members eliminated from the lists had made no payments into the funds nor had they been registered as self-employed. However, no irregularities were reported in the cases.
